sections.heading: Buy through a contract you already have.
body: Our cooperative purchasing contracts let public institutions, school districts, and government entities buy from us without running a standalone RFP or bid.
That means faster timelines, less paperwork, and full compliance with state and federal purchasing guidelines.

faqs.q: How does a cooperative purchasing contract work?
faqs.a: Your organization buys through a contract that has already been competitively bid, such as DIR, OMNIA Partners, NCPA, or GSA. For eligible entities that satisfies the bidding requirement, so you don’t need to run a standalone RFP.

faqs.q: Do we still need board approval or quotes?
faqs.a: That depends on your local policy. Many organizations still take the purchase to their board or compare quotes. We provide the contract numbers and documentation for both.

faqs.q: How long does grant funding take?
faqs.a: It varies by program. Most federal and state grants run on an annual cycle with set application windows, so the earlier you plan, the more options you have. We help you find the programs that fit and build your timeline around their deadlines.

faqs.q: Can we combine more than one funding source?
faqs.a: Yes. Many projects pair a contract purchase with grant funds, E-Rate discounts on eligible networking, or manufacturer co-funding. We map which source covers which part of the build.
12, 24, or 36 months, with predictable monthly payments and built-in hardware refresh cycles. Leasing can be bundled with managed services for a single monthly cost.

faqs.q: Does it cost anything to find out what we qualify for?
faqs.a: No. Your consultation is no-cost. We walk through contracts, grants, and leasing for your organization before you commit to anything.
